output.headline: Dental strategics Heartland and Aspen, plus large financial sponsors, form the buyer universe for this Southeast dental practice; upper-quartile pricing is defensible, though sponsors are stretched.
sentences: Call Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental first: both are High conviction with deals in the target's own sub-sector and can pay comfortably, having closed $409M and $392M deals. [E:tier1]

Defensible pricing is the 75th percentile at 15.4x EBITDA, against a 13.7x median, because the 18.0% margin beats peers; strategics can pay it, but sponsors top out at $68M for a 20% return. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed and merged no one; Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners stay in Tier 2 as technology investors, so confirm their appetite for tech-enabled services before outreach. [E:review, E:tier2]
Most buyers share one motive, geographic expansion, seen in 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead the pitch with the Southeast footprint. [E:motives]
